subject: What does everybody think?
author: ZombieTron
body:
Should I make more Forum categories?

If so what categories would you like to see?

subject: What are you looking for?
author: ZombieTron
body:
I'm sure we can help.

On the Burnout forum there hasn't really been enough posts about the previous games to warrant us doing sections for each game.

Although, we could have a look to see what information we do have in the forums and see if it is worth doing additional sections...

Thanks for the suggestion.

subject: Thanks for considering
author: Dr. Pariolo
body:
Thanks for considering it

Well for starters i was thinking like i mentioned before, a section per game. Just like the webpage has an entry for each "episode" of burnout, i think forum should have a section for each one. And maybe categories for each platforms? pc, playstation, xbox.
